headline: SK Hynix Stock Breaks Below Moving Averages
summary: Shares of SK Hynix have broken down below key moving averages, signaling a potential bearish trend for the semiconductor manufacturer.
why: Technical analysis of moving averages is used by traders to identify momentum shifts in stock prices, particularly for major technology companies.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Breaking below moving averages is a technical indicator of bearish momentum.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Technical selling often triggers further declines as algorithmic and trend-following traders exit positions when key support levels are breached.
